title: b11671
description: model: add Muse Spark Open (text, vision and audio) ( #30616 ) model: add Muse Spark Open (text, vision and audio) Muse Spark Open is a latent space MoE: the residual stream stays at 8192 while the 256 experts live in 4096, with a projection down and up around them, top-8 sigmoid routing with a correction bias. Attention interleaves three sliding layers at a 2048 window with rope for one global layer without rope, with a sigmoid output gate and a weightless QK-norm. Residuals are norm preserving
